import pathlib,json,os,hashlib,subprocess,shutil
root=pathlib.Path('/home/appontrack/public_html')
entries=[]
for p in sorted(root.rglob('*')):
 if not p.is_file() or len(p.relative_to(root).parts)>3:continue
 rel=str(p.relative_to(root))
 if any(x in rel.lower() for x in ['config','secret','.env','token','session','cache','vendor','node_modules','.git']):continue
 if p.suffix.lower() not in ['.php','.js','.mjs','.json','.html','.txt']:continue
 entries.append({'path':rel,'bytes':p.stat().st_size,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()})
print(json.dumps({'uid':os.getuid(),'files':entries[:100],'saas_exists':(root/'saas').exists(),'runtime_tools':{x:shutil.which(x) for x in ['php','python3','node','npm','ffmpeg']},'host_worker_stop_exists':pathlib.Path('/home/appontrack/ontrack-voice-link/STOP').exists()},ensure_ascii=False))
